definitions.explanation: A cat-sized, long-tailed mammal with a white stripe down its face, found in eastern Asia and widespread in Japan. It eats fruit and vegetables and often nests in the roofs and attics of houses, even in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{屋根裏|やねうら}→屋根裏：15854_yaneura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ハクビシン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There is a masked palm civet in the attic.

examples.japanese: ハクビシン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{荒|あ}らされた→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧。
examples.english: Masked palm civets damaged our fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧、⟦{電線|でんせん}→電線：11507_densen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ハクビシン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: At night I spotted a masked palm civet walking along a power line.

notes:
Written {白鼻芯|はくびしん} in kanji, after the white stripe on its nose, but usually in katakana. In Japan it is mostly talked about as a pest: it damages crops and makes noise and mess in attics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハクビシン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧: getting rid of masked palm civets
- ハクビシン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: damage done by masked palm civets

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アライグマ→アライグマ：19309_araiguma⟧: raccoon — an introduced pest of the same kind, told apart by its ringed tail
- タヌキ: raccoon dog — a native animal, with no white stripe on its face
